ev.q: 2,766 persons were offered vaccine and 1,510 (54.6%) agreed to receive it
CDSC staff members identified 5,830 potential contacts of the index patient

methods_quotes.q: Using electronic health records and the state immunization registry, investigators identified persons eligible for hepatitis A vaccination
electronic health records and the state immunization registry were reviewed to remove persons with documented positive hepatitis A serology or vaccination
the index patient’s infectious period was defined as May 9–28
